payload.title: A new site with no theme settings gets the neutral theme
payload.description:
Today a new site has only an accessibility baseline and must write its own stylesheet and hooks.

```gherkin
Feature: Neutral default theme

  Scenario: A site with only a name looks finished
    Given a site whose settings contain only its name
    When the site is built
    Then the home page, section pages and article pages use the neutral theme
    And no site stylesheet or hook was written
```

**Needs Papyrus work:** PPY-31efef (core cards, layout preset, brand pack), PPY-3aa10f (starter).
